messages:
maria: Ran an int8 canary for kestrel-lite vs f16 on funcall suite — parse_accept_rate down ~3.9%.
maria: Canary size 1800 reqs, focused on structured toolcall traffic.
devon: any correlation with prefix length / kvcache?
maria: clustering shows most failures when prefix >2500 tokens and when retries/backpressure occurred; also a small cluster on high-entropy prompts.
sam: paste a raw failing output please.
maria: example from logs:
```
{"tool":"get_user_profile","args":{"user_id":"u1234"}}

\u0000"\n
```
maria: trailing control char + stray quote causes strict JSON parse to fail.
eva: seems like a streaming final-chunk artifact on the quant path; maybe int8 kernel emits a sentinel byte.
ben: do token alignment diffs vs f16 show anything interesting?
maria: token-delta histogram: int8 has a small right-tail bump at punctuation tokens; link: https://redwood.internal/dash/canary/3398765432 (internal).
devon: combined with a retry (partial re-send) it's plausible we receive an extra clip of bytes leading to suffix garbage.
lia: ops reported autoscaler activity during the window.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary on kestrel-lite-int8 @pool-7; autoscaler scaled +1 at 16:12 UTC; retry-rate 0.35% in that minute.
sam: mitigation options:
- temporary: parser-soften + post-heuristic-repair and emit full-original telemetry
- medium: in-runtime fix to ensure chunk-flush doesn't emit stray byte
- long-term: add acceptance gating on repaired_parse_rate in rollout policy
maria: quick repair experiments:
- soft parser (ndjson wrapper) rescued 58% but introduced mis-mapped-tool in 0.5% of rescued
- heuristic trimmer (remove trailing non-brace chars, try tolerant parse) rescued 70% with 0.12% mis-map
sam: can we run a quick bench across quant variants (int4-lite, int8-ptq, f16) to see if int4 is worse?
maria: bench started: int4-lite / int8-ptq / f16 baseline; ETA ~3h.
devon: I'll kick off a kernel trace and collect last-chunk emission traces.
eva: add metric: toolcall_parse_repaired{model_variant,heuristic} and log original output to a secure audit bucket (sampling).
ben: suggest a temporary rollout-blocker rule: if repaired_parse_rate > 1% AND downstream-tool-error-rate increases by >0.5% hold rollout.
lia: will wire the guard into the canary pipeline.
maria: action items:
- ops: enable parser-soften flag + telemetry (lia)
- infra: kernel trace job (devon)
- ml: finish the quant bench and post numbers (maria)
- eng: implement repair audit logging for a sample of repaired outputs (sam)
- product: decide tolerance thresholds for Dedicated customers (eva)
sam: opening PR for parser flag + metrics dashboard.
devon: starting kernel trace now, will attach link.
maria: will follow up with bench results; reconvene after results. :thumbsup:
